intro.label: cinematic_intro
intro.text: It's eleven PM. Your term sheet is due tomorrow. Forty pages deep—and buried inside, Section five caps liability at ten thousand dollars, while Section six says indemnification has no limit. A human skims. A chatbot guesses. Nobody connects the dots. LegalForge doesn't read contracts like a document. It forges a graph—every clause a node—and sends six Jac walkers to hunt contradictions, compliance traps, and deal-killing risk. In minutes. Every finding attributed. A verdict before you sign.

walkthrough.label: landing_value_prop
walkthrough.text: Welcome to LegalForge AI. Manual review misses cross-references buried on page forty. A single large language model hallucinates and cannot prove which clause it read. LegalForge is different: Jac walkers—small graph programs with one job each—traverse a clause knowledge graph in parallel. You get attributed findings, not a black-box paragraph.

walkthrough.label: judge_demo_login
walkthrough.text: For judges we run the live judge demo. One click signs you in as contract analyst and opens a curated mutual NDA—no setup, no API keys on stage.

walkthrough.label: nda_trap
walkthrough.text: Here is the mutual NDA between Acme Corp and your startup. The sample ships with a deliberate trap: Section five point two caps your liability at ten thousand dollars, while Section six point one indemnification has no cap. Sign as-is and you eat unlimited downside while your recovery stays tiny.

walkthrough.label: dispatch_swarm
walkthrough.text: Dispatch the walker swarm. Six specialists leave the root of the clause graph—each walker spawned from real Jac code, not one monolithic prompt.

walkthrough.label: walker_parser
walkthrough.text: Parser walker first: segments the contract, normalizes headings, and spawns one node per clause on the knowledge graph.

walkthrough.label: walker_contradiction
walkthrough.text: Contradiction walker compares clause pairs adversarially—this is where capped liability versus uncapped indemnity gets caught.

walkthrough.label: walker_compliance
walkthrough.text: Compliance walker cross-references statutes—UCC, GDPR, CCPA, SOX—against each clause's obligations.

walkthrough.label: walker_risk
walkthrough.text: Risk scorer applies a weighted rubric per clause so exposure is ranked, not guessed.

walkthrough.label: walker_negotiation
walkthrough.text: Negotiation walker drafts safer alternative language—a proposer–critic loop until risk drops.

walkthrough.label: walker_report
walkthrough.text: Report walker synthesizes the executive brief and audit trail for counsel.

walkthrough.label: verdict_command_center
walkthrough.text: Command center: the forge stamps your verdict—negotiate, review, or sign-ready—with time saved versus manual review. Story banner explains the headline risk in plain English.

walkthrough.label: issue_spotlight
walkthrough.text: Issue spotlight: click the liability mismatch. You see both clauses, severity, and which walker filed the finding—full attribution.

walkthrough.label: graph_negotiation
walkthrough.text: Clause knowledge graph: crimson edges are contradictions. Drag nodes, trace paths. The finding rail shows negotiation proposals—redline language you can export.

walkthrough.label: jac_for_judges
walkthrough.text: For judges: each agent tile maps to a Jac walker file—parser, contradiction, compliance, risk, negotiation, report. Walkers are APIs on a graph-native runtime, not a wrapper around one chat completion.

closing.label: closing
closing.text: LegalForge AI. JacHacks Spring twenty twenty-six. Verdict before you sign.
